name: Authenticator
description: Two-factor codes from your authenticator’s export, as a column. ↵ pastes the current code. Reads otpauth links and LastPass, Google, Aegis, 2FAS and Bitwarden exports; codes are never stored or shown.
source.title: Authenticator
code.title: Paste code
code.label: Code
accounts.title: Accounts
setUp: Paste your authenticator’s export into Accounts, in Settings › Extensions › Authenticator.
encrypted: This {app} export is encrypted. Export again without a password, then paste it into Accounts in Settings.
noTotp: No time-based accounts in this export. HOTP and Steam accounts aren’t supported.
unrecognized: No accounts found. Paste otpauth links, or an export from LastPass, Google, Aegis, 2FAS or Bitwarden, into Accounts in Settings.
gone: This account is no longer in Accounts in Settings.
readFailed: The accounts in Settings couldn’t be read.
noCode: There’s no code for this row.
